strings.homeMcp: MCP (Model Context Protocol) yana ba da damar mataimakan AI masu jituwa su haɗa zuwa kayan aikin waje. Poly-Glot yana fallasa gano samfuri, ginin gaggawa, da shirye-shiryen kwatance. Shirya kwatance baya tuntuɓar masu samar da AI da aka zaɓa ta atomatik ko dawo da amsoshinsu.
strings.claudeAccess: Samuwar haɗin haɗin al'ada na Claude ya dogara da shirin ku na Claude na yanzu, sigar app, da izinin sararin aiki. Yi amfani da Saituna → Masu haɗawa idan akwai.
strings.chatIntro: Haɗa Poly-Glot azaman ƙa'idar MCP mai nisa ko mai haɗawa ta al'ada lokacin da asusun ChatGPT ɗinku ke goyan bayansa ko filin aiki. Samuwar da izini sun dogara da tsarin ku da saitunanku.
strings.chatStep1: Duba ChatGPT Apps ko saitunan masu haɓakawa
strings.chatStep1Body: Buɗe aikace-aikacen da ke akwai ko tsarin MCP na al'ada a cikin ChatGPT. Shirinku, filin aiki, da mai gudanarwa na iya taƙaita wannan fasalin.
strings.chatStep2: Ƙara wurin ƙarshen HTTP mai gudana mai gudana
strings.chatStep2Body: Lokacin da asusunku yana goyan bayan sabar MCP mai nisa na al'ada, samar da ainihin URL ɗin da ke ƙasa kuma kammala duk wani tabbaci da ake buƙata.
strings.chatStep3: Yarda da kayan aikin kuma tabbatar da shiga
strings.chatStep3Body: Sake sabunta kayan aikin da aka gano kuma gwada samun_language_options ko search_templates. Shiga tare da ingantattun asusun Poly-Glot don kunna gwaji, Aika ayyuka, da samun shiga. (get_language_options)
strings.chatNoteBody: Samun damar kayan aiki ya dogara da abokin ciniki da izini. GUI da aka haɗa sararin aiki bazai iya bayarwa a kowane abokin ciniki na MCP ba. Poly-Glot baya yin alƙawarin jeri na Store Store ko shigarwa ta danna sau ɗaya ta atomatik.
strings.chatHelpLink: Karanta matsala na ChatGPT MCP na yanzu →
strings.toolGetTemplate: Sami filayen samfuri; Ana mayar da gawarwakin da aka biya da sauri ne kawai lokacin da asusun ya cancanci
strings.compareExample: Kayan aikin shirya_compare ya dawo da sauri guda ɗaya da shirin ChatGPT, Claude, da Gemini. Ba ya kiran waɗannan masu samarwa kai tsaye ko tattara amsoshinsu; yi amfani da kowane zaɓaɓɓen AI kuma kwatanta sakamakon da kanka. (prepare_compare)
strings.freeAnswer: Gwajin cikakken isa na kwanaki 3 da aikace-aikacen ke farawa a farkon cancantar Aika bayan tabbatar da asusun kuma baya juyewa kai tsaye zuwa biyan kuɗi da aka biya. Bayan ya ƙare, samfuran kyauta 25 da Aika-AI guda ɗaya a kowace sa'o'i 24 masu birgima suna nan; Kwatanta Yanayin, BYOM, kayan aikin sarrafa harshe, da samfuran Pro suna buƙatar gwaji mai aiki ko biyan kuɗi na Pro.
strings.appAnswer: Kuna iya bincika kayan aikin MCP kyauta daga abokin ciniki masu jituwa. Fara gwajin da amfani da ƙayyadaddun kayan aikin yana buƙatar ingantacciyar asusun Poly-Glot, kuma siyan kuɗin Apple ko maidowa na iya buƙatar ƙa'idar ta asali. Tallafin abokin ciniki na MCP da wadatar GUI da aka haɗa sun bambanta.
strings.privacyAnswer: Sabar ta MCP tana aiwatar da buƙatun kayan aiki kuma tana yin rikodin metadata na amfani da aiki. Samfurin na yau da kullun da kayan aikin jiwuwa na iya aika abun ciki da aka bayar ga zaɓaɓɓen mai ba da sarrafawa. Kar a haɗa da sirrika a cikin buƙatun tallafi ko bayanan jama'a. Bitar da
strings.privacyCollection: Za a iya adana tarihin ƙa'ida da saitunan akan na'urarka. Lokacin da kake amfani da sabis na AI da aka haɗa ko uwar garken MCP na Poly-Glot, ana aika buƙatun zuwa sabis ɗin da aka zaɓa. MCP na baya yana tabbatar da haƙƙin asusu kuma yana yin rikodin metadata na aiki kamar amfanin kayan aiki da kurakurai; ana buƙatar asusun shiga don kunna gwaji da ƙuntataccen ayyukan Aika. Kar a ƙaddamar da kalmomin shiga, maɓallan API, ko rasidu masu zaman kansu a cikin saƙonnin tallafi.
strings.privacyPurchases: Apple yana aiwatar da biyan kuɗin biyan kuɗi na cikin-app. Poly-Glot na iya tantancewa da yin rikodin yanayin haƙƙin biyan kuɗi ko masu gano ma'amalar Apple don tantance damar fasalin; Apple ne ke sarrafa bayanan katin biyan kuɗi, ba ta wannan gidan yanar gizon ba.
strings.privacyServices: Wannan gidan yanar gizon yana amfani da Google Analytics da TikTok pixel talla. Maziyartan gidan yanar gizon suna iya samun bayanan bincike da ma'amala da waɗannan ayyuka ke sarrafa su ƙarƙashin manufofinsu. Masu ba da AI, zaɓi na zaɓi na ƙarshe na ƙirar ƙira, sabis na gane magana, da masu samar da sauti/rubutu na iya aiwatar da abun ciki lokacin da kuka zaɓi aika shi. Sharuɗɗan keɓancewar su suna aiki.
strings.termsWhat: In native-app workflows, Poly-Glot zai iya ku dacewa da kuma za a kan halitta, da dai sauransu ka yi AI don samun. MCP kayayyakin yana aiki daga cikin remote server wanda ya ci gaba abokan ciniki da kuma samar da sa'aikace. Provider yanar da kuma amfani da shi ne ba tare da ce service da kuma workflow.
strings.termsCompare: Yadda za a iya da wani samfurin da kuma samar da yanarwa don amfani da kayan aiki. The MCP prepar_compare tool ne ta hanyar yanarwar da kuma ba tare da yanare. (prepare_compare)
strings.termsTrial: The app-managed 3-day full-access trial ya ce a cikin farko kwarewa Santar da aka'antu ta hanyar aka'antun; sa'an za ka iya kayayyakin don hakkiya da kuma ko ba tare da wani bayar abokan ciniki. A kan rufe wannan app ko mai kyau na'urorin, zai yi amfani da wani sabon trial for the same verified account.
strings.termsGated: Sa'an kamfanoni-tallace, wannan kayayyakin za a iya wani Pro abokan ciniki; A kan Your Own Model da kuma MCP aiki tare da ƙarfi ne mai amfani:
strings.termsPrivacy: App History da kuma Settings iya rufe a kan aiki, amma mahimmanci a cikin karantawa AI da dai sauransu MCP kayayyakin za ka iya sa'a da wannan ayyuka. Poly-Glot's MCP server ta hanyar akafin hakar da tsarin aiki metadata; custom-model da kuma transcription workflows yana amfani da samar da ƙananin tare da selected processors. The website also uses analytics and advertising pixels. Review the Privacy Policy and each provider's terms.
strings.pricingPrivacy: App History da kuma Settings yana iya sa'an aiki. Sa'an ƙarfin shi ne ka selected AI provider, a lokacin da remote MCP requests pass through the Poly-Glot server. The MCP service verifies rights and records operational use metadata; processing providers have their own privacy policies.
strings.pricingVoice: Voice input iya amfani da on-device na'urorin yanayin, tare da server-based fallback ta hanyar don kayan aiki da tsarin. The MCP transcribe_audio tool sends supplied audio to its configured transcription provider and requires active trial or Pro access.
strings.pricingTrial: The app-managed 3-day full access trial yana da farko kwarewa Sunan for a verified account. It don't automatically convert into a paid Apple abokan ciniki. A kan ciniki da kuma cutar a bayar abokancin za ka iya sauri akafi.
strings.pricingExpired: Sa'an tsari, 25 free templates yana da kayayyakin, tare da wani single-AI Send samar da sa'an aiki a kan 24 hours. Pro templates, Comparare Mode, BYOM execution and MCP language processing tools require an active trial or Pro; the trial itself never starts a paid subscription.
strings.compareHow: Poly-Glot ya ce a kan da wani kofi na'ura don ƙarƙa. The app yana amfani da samfurin yanar da kuma tare da abokan ciniki ta hanyar. The MCP prepar_compare tool stages prompts and provider instructions; it doesn't automatically invoke models or collect answers. (prepare_compare)
strings.compareAuto: No. Yana da wani AI providers za a amfani. A MCP client, prepare_compare ya yi a cikin samar da kuma ba tare da samar da samar. Sa'an, sa'an da kuma sa'anin yanar kowa ta hanyar wannan app ko-client da kuma wasu provider.
strings.templatesFree: Yana da 25 wani free templates. Surfing da kuma searching ne kawai a kan; limitated Pro template bodies zai iya sa'a ko ka aka'an aiki na tsakiya ko Pro hakkiya. A cikin 3 daga tsakija, free template yana da kayayyakin amma Pro templates da kuma Comparare Mode Lock.
strings.templatesPro: No pay subscription is required to browse or use the limited free level. A tafi account is needed to start a trial or use restricted Send actions. Pro unlock restricted templates, Comparare Mode and unlimited sends, plus eligible BYOM da MCP language-processing features.
strings.languagesCount: Poly-Glot yana da 38 na'urorin tafiya, ciki har da sauri a kan Arabic da Hebrew, da kuma abokan ciniki kayayyakin. MCP language detection, translation, localization and transcription ne separated limited processing tools that require an active trial or Pro subscription.
strings.mcpIntro: Poly-Glot ya ce a hotuna Streamable HTTP Model Context Protocol server tare da kayayyakin for template discovery, prompt building, comparison preparation, BYOM, language and audio processing, kuma abokan ciniki status. Read-only discovery don't start a trial; Send and restricted tools use verified server-side rights.
strings.mcpCount: The current MCP server code registers 15 kayayyakin: 7 core kayayyaki, 4 BYOM kayayyaka, da kuma four language and audio kayayyak. Discovery yana amfani da customer support da ƙarfi; wasu kayayyakan aiki za a iya wani al'ura ko Pro account.
